hypothesis: On the exact current-main v10 owner, a cancellation becoming visible after release dequeue but before dispatch is attached to the active lease release record; ordinary release remains unchanged.
treatment: Run one deterministic owner-thread queue interleaving against exact input_owner_v10.py with fake Xlib. A queue hook sets lease.cancel only after the owner loop's pre-dequeue check and after it retrieves the explicit release request. Run one ordinary-release positive control.
decision: C01 supports the defect if cancel case reports reason release while verified-empty; ordinary control must report release. A later versioned candidate must report cancelled for the cancel case and release for ordinary control.
scope: Actual v10 owner thread and request handler, deterministic scheduler hook, fake Xlib state. No ExecutorV12 wrapper or game integration.
limits: No X server, device input, application, game, model, useful task feedback, bounded recovery guarantee, matched performance comparison, or formal/live allocation.
host_image: Local Windows host; CPython 3.11 (no container, selected because WSLc currently has another active study container)
